packageRules.description: The pg majors in pgrx-base-images.toml are the support matrix, not staleness: each key deliberately maps to its own major (building 14 against 18 is not an update, it is a different matrix). Only digest and suffix refreshes within each major flow; new majors enter by adding a key, a reviewed change.

customManagers.description: pgrx base images: keep tag AND digest current together in docker/pgrx-base-images.toml — a pinned-but-stale base is worse than a floating one
